Linux load'ga D state ham kiradi — shuning uchun NFS osilib qolsa CPU bo'sh, load 100 bo'lishi mumkin.
Senior: load o'zi metrika emas, signal. PSI (`/proc/pressure`) va latency (p99) — haqiqiy ta'sir. `steal` (st) yuqori bo'lsa — VPS qo'shnisi CPU yeyapti, muammo sizda emas.

31424.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Linux'da har process ochadigan fayl deskriptorlari (fayl, socket, pipe) soni cheklangan: process limiti `RLIMIT_NOFILE` (`ulimit -n`, ko'pincha default 1024) va tizim limiti `fs.file-max`. Limitga yetsa `EMFILE: Too many open files`. To'g'ri sozlash: systemd servisida `LimitNOFILE=`, login sessiyalar uchun `/etc/security/limits.conf`. Lekin avval — bu haqiqiy ehtiyojmi yoki fd leak?

**Muammo:** 2000 ta WebSocket client'li ilova 1024 limitga yetadi — yangi ulanishlar rad etiladi, log fayl ham ochilmaydi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
process fd jadvali: 0 stdin, 1 stdout, 2 stderr, 3 log, 4.. socket'lar
       soft limit (ulimit -n)  <=  hard limit  <=  fs.nr_open
       tizim bo'yicha jami      <=  fs.file-max
limitlar qayerdan:
  login shell    <- PAM pam_limits <- /etc/security/limits.conf
  systemd servis <- unit faylidagi LimitNOFILE (limits.conf ta'sir QILMAYDI)
  container      <- runtime (--ulimit nofile=)
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
cat /proc/<pid>/limits | grep 'open files'   # process'ning HAQIQIY limiti
ls /proc/<pid>/fd | wc -l                     # hozir nechta ochiq
lsof -p <pid> | awk '{print $5}' | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn   # turi: IPv4, REG, FIFO
ss -tanp | grep 'pid=<pid>' | awk '{print $1}' | sort | uniq -c # CLOSE_WAIT ko'pmi
sysctl fs.file-nr                             # tizim: ishlatilgan / max
```
systemd servis uchun:
```bash
sudo systemctl edit app
# [Service]
# LimitNOFILE=65536
sudo systemctl daemon-reload && sudo systemctl restart app
cat /proc/$(pidof app)/limits | grep 'open files'   # tasdiqlash
```

**Leak yoki ehtiyoj:**
```bash
watch -n 60 'ls /proc/<pid>/fd | wc -l'
```
Son yuk bilan birga o'sib-tushsa — ehtiyoj, limitni oshir. Yuk tushganda ham to'xtovsiz o'ssa — **leak**: yopilmagan HTTP response body (Go'da `resp.Body.Close()`), fayl, DB connection. Ko'p `CLOSE_WAIT` — ilova socket'ni yopmayapti.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `limits.conf`ni o'zgartirib systemd servisini restart qilish — hech narsa o'zgarmaydi.
- `ulimit -n` joriy shell'ni ko'rsatadi, ishlab turgan process'nikini emas — `/proc/<pid>/limits`ga qara.
- Limitni 1 mln ga ko'tarib leak'ni "tuzatish" — faqat kechiktiradi, keyin xotira yoki ephemeral portlar tugaydi.

**Senior nuqta:** fd sonini metrikaga chiqar (`process_open_fds` / `process_max_fds`) va 80% da alert qo'y. Limit — xavfsizlik to'sig'i ham: cheksiz qilish bitta buggy process'ning butun tizimni yiqitishiga yo'l ochadi.

31425.a:
**Qisqa javob:** journald — systemd'ning binary log tizimi (servis stdout/stderr), rsyslog — klassik matnli log va masofaga yuborish, logrotate — matnli fayllarni aylantirish. Diskni to'ldirmaslik uchun: journald'ga `SystemMaxUse`, har bir matnli log uchun logrotate qoidasi (hajm bilan ham), Docker log driver limiti, alohida `/var/log` bo'limi va disk alert'i; asosiy log'lar markaziy tizimga yuboriladi.

**Muammo:** debug darajadagi log yoqilib qoldi — bir kechada 60 GB, `/` 100%, DB yozolmay to'xtadi.

**Qanday oqadi:**
```
app (stdout) --> journald (/var/log/journal, SystemMaxUse bilan cheklangan)
                    | ForwardToSyslog
                    v
                 rsyslog --> /var/log/syslog, /var/log/app.log  (logrotate aylantiradi)
                    | omfwd / agent (Vector, Fluent Bit, Promtail)
                    v
              markaziy log (Loki / Elasticsearch / CloudWatch)
```

**Amalda:**
```ini
# /etc/systemd/journald.conf.d/size.conf
[Journal]
SystemMaxUse=1G
SystemKeepFree=2G
MaxRetentionSec=14day
```
```
# /etc/logrotate.d/app
/var/log/app/*.log {
    daily
    maxsize 500M          # kun tugamasa ham hajm bo'yicha
    rotate 14
    compress
    delaycompress
    missingok
    notifempty
    create 0640 app app
    postrotate
        systemctl kill -s HUP app.service || true
    endscript
}
```
```bash
sudo systemctl restart systemd-journald
journalctl --disk-usage
sudo journalctl --vacuum-size=500M        # darhol tozalash
sudo logrotate -d /etc/logrotate.d/app    # dry-run
du -sh /var/log/* | sort -h | tail
journalctl -u app --since "1 hour ago" -p err
```

**`copytruncate` vs signal:**
| | `copytruncate` | `create` + signal (HUP/reopen) |
|---|---|---|
| Ilova o'zgarishi | kerak emas | faylni qayta ochishni bilishi kerak |
| Yo'qotish | nusxa va truncate orasidagi qatorlar | yo'q |
| Katta fayl | nusxa vaqtida disk 2x | yo'q |

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Fayl o'chirildi, ilova hali yozmoqda — `df` bo'shamaydi: `lsof +L1`, ilovani reopen/restart qil.
- Docker default `json-file` limitsiz — `daemon.json`da `max-size`/`max-file`.
- Log'ga parol, token, PII yozilishi — rotate qilingan arxivlarda ham qoladi; ilovada redaction qil.

**Senior nuqta:** Server'dagi log — vaqtinchalik bufer. Haqiqiy manba — markaziy tizim (structured JSON, correlation ID, retention siyosati). Log hajmini ham budjet qil: debug'ni dinamik yoq/o'chir, sampling ishlat.

31426.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `nohup` va `screen`/`tmux` — vaqtinchalik, qo'lda ishga tushirish usullari: crash'da qayta ko'tarilmaydi, reboot'dan keyin yo'q, log tarqoq. Production uchun to'g'risi — **systemd service** (yoki container orchestrator): avtomatik restart, boot'da start, journald log, alohida user, resurs limitlari va sandboxing.

**Muammo:** ilova `nohup ./api &` bilan root'dan ishga tushirilgan. Kechasi panic bo'ldi — ertalabgacha hech kim qayta ko'tarmadi. Reboot'dan keyin umuman yo'q.

**Taqqoslash:**
| | nohup | tmux/screen | systemd |
|---|---|---|---|
| Crash'da restart | yo'q | yo'q | `Restart=on-failure` |
| Boot'da start | yo'q | yo'q | `enable` |
| Log | fayl (qo'lda) | ekran | journald |
| User/limit/sandbox | yo'q | yo'q | bor |
| Holat | `ps` qidirish | qo'lda | `systemctl status` |

**Amalda:**
```ini
# /etc/systemd/system/app.service
[Unit]
Description=My API
After=network-online.target
Wants=network-online.target

[Service]
User=app
Group=app
WorkingDirectory=/opt/app
EnvironmentFile=/etc/app/env
ExecStart=/opt/app/bin/api
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=2
TimeoutStopSec=30            # graceful shutdown uchun vaqt
LimitNOFILE=65536
MemoryMax=1G                 # cgroup limiti: server emas, ilova o'ladi
# sandboxing (himoya)
NoNewPrivileges=true
ProtectSystem=strict
ProtectHome=true
PrivateTmp=true
ReadWritePaths=/var/lib/app

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
```
```bash
sudo useradd --system --no-create-home --shell /usr/sbin/nologin app
sudo systemctl daemon-reload
sudo systemctl enable --now app
systemctl status app
journalctl -u app -f
systemd-analyze security app      # sandbox bahosi: 9.6 UNSAFE -> past = yaxshi
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `Restart=always` + tez crash — cheksiz loop; `StartLimitBurst`/`StartLimitIntervalSec` va restart sonini monitoring qil.
- `After=network.target` yetmaydi — tarmoq tayyor bo'lishini kutish uchun `network-online.target` + `Wants`.
- Ilova root bilan — buzilsa butun server qo'lga o'tadi. Alohida tizim user'i.
- `ProtectSystem=strict` qo'yib `ReadWritePaths` unutilsa — ilova yozolmaydi ("Read-only file system").

**Senior nuqta:** Konteyner/K8s'ga o'tsang ham g'oya bir xil: supervisor, restart siyosati, resurs limiti, least privilege. systemd sandboxing — deyarli bepul defense in depth; yangi servisda `systemd-analyze security` bahosini tushirishni odat qil.

31429.a:
Ansible — idempotent: necha marta ishlatsang ham natija bir xil.
```yaml
- hosts: web
  become: true
  tasks:
    - name: nginx o'rnatilgan
      apt: { name: nginx, state: present }
    - name: config
      template: { src: nginx.conf.j2, dest: /etc/nginx/nginx.conf }

```
`ansible-playbook site.yml --check --diff` — nima o'zgarishini oldindan ko'r.
Trade-off: mutable (Ansible har safar server ustida) — tez, lekin drift ehtimoli; immutable (yangi image, eski serverni o'chir) — bashorat qilinadigan, lekin build pipeline kerak.
Qoida: production serverga SSH bilan kirib qo'lda tuzatish — hodisa; keyin albatta kodga ko'chiriladi.

31430.a:
Tartib:
1. Faqat sizdami? Boshqa joydan, `mtr host`, status page, monitoring.
2. Cloud console: instance status check (system vs instance), CPU/disk grafik.
3. Serial/VNC console orqali kir — firewall/sshd xatosi bo'lsa ham ishlaydi.
4. Boot bo'lmasa: rescue mode / diskni boshqa instance'ga ulab tuzat (`/etc/fstab` xatosi klassik sabab — `nofail` qo'shilmagan).
5. Reboot oxirgi chora — avval dalil to'pla:
```
journalctl -b -1 -p err      # oldingi boot xatolari
dmesg -T | grep -i -E 'oom|panic|i/o error'
last -x | head               # reboot/shutdown tarixi
```
Senior: "server o'ldi" — bitta server yiqilishi servis yiqilishiga olib kelmasligi kerak (≥2 instance + LB). Tiklash vaqti (MTTR) — runbook va alertlar sifatiga bog'liq.

31431.a:
Minimal ro'yxat:
- CPU: usage, steal, load / PSI
- Memory: available (free emas!), swap in/out, OOM kill soni
- Disk: % to'lishi + **to'lish tezligi** (`predict_linear`), inode, I/O latency
- Network: errors/drops, connection soni (TIME_WAIT, conntrack table)
- Host: up, vaqt siljishi, reboot-required, sertifikat muddati
```
# Prometheus: 4 soatda disk to'ladi
predict_linear(node_filesystem_avail_bytes{mountpoint="/"}[6h], 4*3600) < 0
```
Anti-pattern: "CPU > 80%" alerti tunda uyg'otadi, lekin foydalanuvchi zarar ko'rmaydi. Page — faqat foydalanuvchiga ta'sir (error rate, latency SLO burn); qolgani ticket.
Monitoring server tashqarisida bo'lsin — server o'lsa, o'zi haqida xabar bera olmaydi (absent/up==0 alert).

31432.a:
```
# /etc/sysctl.d/90-web.conf
net.core.somaxconn = 4096               # listen backlog (app'da ham backlog oshirilsin)
net.ipv4.tcp_max_syn_backlog = 8192
net.ipv4.ip_local_port_range = 10240 65535   # ko'p outbound connection (proxy)
net.ipv4.tcp_tw_reuse = 1               # outbound TIME_WAIT qayta ishlatish
net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max = 262144
vm.swappiness = 10
sysctl --system                          # qo'llash
```
Belgilar: `nstat -az | grep -i ListenOverflows` (backlog to'lgan), `dmesg | grep conntrack` ("table full, dropping packet"), `ss -s` (TIME_WAIT soni).
Gotcha: `tcp_tw_recycle` — o'chirilgan (4.12+), NAT ortida client'larni buzardi; internetdagi eski maslahatlarga ishonma.
Senior: tuning — oxirgi qadam; avval connection pooling/keep-alive (TIME_WAIT'ning asl sababi ko'pincha shu).

31433.a:
Tartib (incident response):
1. **Contain**: SG/firewall bilan tarmoqdan ajrat (faqat sizning IP), LB'dan chiqar. O'chirma — RAM'dagi dalil yo'qoladi.
2. **Preserve**: disk snapshot, `ps auxf`, `ss -tnp`, `ls -l /proc/<pid>/exe`, crontab'lar, `~/.ssh/authorized_keys`, `last`, `/var/log/auth.log` nusxasi.
3. **Analyze**: kirish yo'li — zaif ilova, sizib chiqqan key, ochiq Redis/Docker API, eski CVE.
4. **Eradicate**: yangi serverni toza image'dan qur; eski diskni faqat tekshirish uchun saqla.
5. **Rotate**: shu serverda bo'lgan barcha secret (DB parol, API key, SSH key, cloud credential).
6. **Postmortem**: qanday aniqlandi, qancha vaqt sezilmadi, qaysi nazorat ishlamadi.
```
ls -l /proc/*/exe 2>/dev/null | grep deleted   # diskdan o'chirilgan binary ishlayapti
crontab -l; ls /etc/cron.* /var/spool/cron
```
Nega tozalab bo'lmaydi: rootkit `ps`/`ls`'ni almashtirgan bo'lishi mumkin — server o'z-o'zi haqida yolg'on gapiradi.

31434.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `ssh` — serverga shifrlangan terminal ulanish. `scp` — SSH orqali faylni bir martalik nusxalash (har safar hammasini). `rsync` — SSH orqali sinxronlash: faqat o'zgargan qismlarni yuboradi, uzilsa davom etadi, `--delete` bilan mirror qiladi. Kundalik deploy/backup uchun `rsync`, bitta fayl uchun `scp` ham yetadi.

**Nega kalit bilan:** parol bilan kirish brute force'ga ochiq. SSH kalit (ed25519) — private kalit sizda, public kalit serverdagi `~/.ssh/authorized_keys`da.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
laptop (private key) --SSH 22--> server (authorized_keys'da public key)
   ssh    -> shell
   scp    -> fayl to'liq ko'chiriladi
   rsync  -> fayl ro'yxati solishtiriladi -> faqat farqlar
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C "ali@laptop"           # kalit juftligi
ssh-copy-id -i ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub deploy@203.0.113.10
ssh deploy@203.0.113.10

scp app.tar.gz deploy@host:/tmp/                # yuborish
scp deploy@host:/var/log/app.log .              # olish
rsync -avz --progress ./dist/ deploy@host:/opt/app/
rsync -avzn --delete ./dist/ deploy@host:/opt/app/   # dry-run, keyin -n'siz
```
`~/.ssh/config` bilan qisqartirish:
```
Host prod
  HostName 203.0.113.10
  User deploy
  IdentityFile ~/.ssh/id_ed25519
```
Endi: `ssh prod`, `rsync -avz dist/ prod:/opt/app/`.

| | scp | rsync |
|---|---|---|
| Takroriy ko'chirish | hammasini qayta | faqat farq |
| Uzilsa | boshidan | `-P` bilan davom |
| O'chirilganlarni sinxron | yo'q | `--delete` |

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `dist/` (ichidagilar) va `dist` (papkaning o'zi) — oxirgi `/` natijani o'zgartiradi; `--delete` bilan xato juda qimmat.
- Private kalitga parol (passphrase) qo'yilmagan va laptop o'g'irlangan — server ochiq. Passphrase + `ssh-agent`.
- `Permissions 0644 for 'id_ed25519' are too open` — `chmod 600 ~/.ssh/id_ed25519`.

**Senior nuqta:** Serverda `PasswordAuthentication no`, `PermitRootLogin no`. Jamoada shaxsiy kalit tarqatish o'rniga SSH sertifikatlar (qisqa muddatli) yoki SSM/Teleport — kirish markazdan beriladi va bekor qilinadi.

31435.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Tez "sog'liq" tekshiruvi: `uptime` (load), `free -h` (RAM — `available` ustuni), `df -h` va `df -i` (disk va inode), `htop`/`top` (qaysi process yeyapti), `ss -tlnp` (qaysi portlar ochiq va qaysi process), `systemctl --failed` va `journalctl -p err -b` (xatolar).

**Nega shu tartibda:** birinchi daqiqada resurs tugaganmi (CPU, RAM, disk) yoki servis yiqilganmi — shuni aniqlash kerak. Har buyruq bitta savolga javob beradi.

**Amalda:**
```bash
uptime
# 14:02:11 up 12 days, load average: 7.80, 6.10, 3.20   <- 1/5/15 daqiqa; CPU soni bilan solishtir
nproc                            # 4 yadro: load 7.8 = navbat bor

free -h
#        total  used  free  shared  buff/cache  available
# Mem:    7.7G  5.1G  210M    50M      2.4G       2.3G   <- available'ga qara

df -h                            # Use% 100% bormi
df -i                            # inode tugaganmi
htop                             # F6 bilan CPU/MEM bo'yicha saralash
ss -tlnp                         # LISTEN 0.0.0.0:22 users:(("sshd",pid=812))
systemctl --failed               # yiqilgan servislar
journalctl -p err -b --no-pager | tail -30
vmstat 1 5                       # wa (I/O kutish), si/so (swap)
```

**O'qish:**
| Ko'rsatkich | Xavfli belgi |
|---|---|
| load > yadro soni (uzoq) | CPU yoki I/O navbati |
| `available` < 10% | xotira bosimi, OOM yaqin |
| `Use%` > 90% | disk tez orada to'ladi |
| `vmstat` `wa` yuqori | disk sekin |
| `ss`da `0.0.0.0:5432` | DB tashqariga ochiq bo'lishi mumkin |

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `free` ustunidagi kichik son normal — Linux bo'sh RAM'ni page cache'ga ishlatadi; haqiqiy ko'rsatkich `available`.
- Load average faqat CPU emas — D state'dagi (disk kutayotgan) process'lar ham kiradi.
- `df` bo'sh desa ham yozib bo'lmasa — inode yoki o'chirilgan-lekin-ochiq fayl (`lsof +L1`).

**Senior nuqta:** Bu buyruqlar — favqulodda holat uchun. Production'da shu ko'rsatkichlar (node_exporter) doimiy metrikada va alert'da bo'lishi kerak — SSH'ga kirishdan oldin dashboard javob bersin.

31436.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Zamonaviy Linux'da servislar systemd orqali boshqariladi: `systemctl start|stop|restart|reload|status <servis>`, boot'da ishga tushishi uchun `enable`, log'lar uchun `journalctl -u <servis>`.

**Nega systemd:** u servisni kuzatadi (yiqilsa qayta ko'taradi), log'larni yig'adi, bog'liqliklar tartibini boshqaradi — qo'lda `nohup` bilan ishga tushirishdan ishonchli.

**Buyruqlar:**
```
start    -> ishga tushirish (hozir)
stop     -> to'xtatish (SIGTERM, keyin timeout'da SIGKILL)
restart  -> stop + start (ulanishlar uziladi)
reload   -> config'ni qayta o'qish, process o'lmaydi (servis qo'llasa)
enable   -> boot'da avtomatik (symlink yaratadi), hozir start qilmaydi
enable --now -> ikkalasi
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
systemctl status nginx
# Active: active (running) since ...      <- holat
# Main PID: 1234 (nginx)
# ... oxirgi log qatorlari
sudo systemctl restart nginx
sudo systemctl reload nginx
sudo systemctl enable --now nginx
systemctl is-enabled nginx; systemctl is-active nginx
systemctl --failed

journalctl -u nginx -f                    # jonli kuzatish
journalctl -u nginx --since "10 min ago"
journalctl -u nginx -b -p err             # shu boot'dagi xatolar
```
Config o'zgartirgach, avval tekshir:
```bash
sudo nginx -t && sudo systemctl reload nginx
sudo sshd -t && sudo systemctl reload ssh
```
Unit faylni o'zgartirgan bo'lsang: `sudo systemctl daemon-reload`.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Xato config bilan `restart` — servis umuman ko'tarilmaydi (SSH bo'lsa — serverga kirish yo'qoladi). `-t` + `reload`.
- `enable` qilinmagan servis reboot'dan keyin ishlamaydi — "kecha ishlayotgan edi".
- Unit fayl tahrirlandi, `daemon-reload` unutildi — eski sozlama bilan ishlaydi.
- `/usr/lib/systemd/system/` dagi faylni to'g'ridan tahrirlash — paket yangilanishida yo'qoladi; `systemctl edit nginx` (override) ishlat.

**Senior nuqta:** SSH config'ni masofadan o'zgartirganda joriy sessiyani yopma — ikkinchi terminalda yangi ulanishni sinab ko'r. `Restart=on-failure` va health check bilan servis o'zini tiklaydi, lekin restart sonini metrikada kuzat — "jimgina crash loop" yashiringan muammo.

31437.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Cron — vazifalarni jadval bo'yicha ishga tushiruvchi daemon. Sintaksis: `daqiqa soat oy_kuni oy hafta_kuni buyruq`. Keng tarqalgan xatolar: minimal PATH, `%` belgisini ekranlamaslik, chiqishni log'ga yo'naltirmaslik, timezone va job'ning ikki marta parallel ishlashi.

**Amalda:**
```
# m   h  dom mon dow  command
*/5   *  *   *   *    /opt/app/bin/cleanup >> /var/log/cleanup.log 2>&1
0     3  *   *   *    /usr/local/bin/backup.sh
0     9  *   *   1-5  /opt/app/report.sh                # ish kunlari 09:00
0     0  1   *   *    /opt/app/monthly.sh               # har oy 1-sanasi
```
```bash
crontab -e            # o'z jadvali
crontab -l
ls /etc/cron.d/       # tizim/paket job'lari (user maydoni bilan)
grep CRON /var/log/syslog | tail
```

**Xatolar va yechimlar:**
| Xato | Belgisi | Yechim |
|---|---|---|
| Minimal PATH | qo'lda ishlaydi, cron'da `command not found` | to'liq yo'l yoki `PATH=` qatori |
| `%` maxsus belgi | buyruq kesilib qoladi | `date +\%F` |
| Chiqish yo'q | xato ko'rinmaydi | `>> log 2>&1` |
| Parallel ishlash | oldingi tugamay keyingisi boshlanadi | `flock -n /run/lock/x.lock cmd` |
| Timezone | "noto'g'ri vaqtda" ishlaydi | `timedatectl`, UTC hisobla |
| Env yo'q | `.bashrc` o'qilmaydi | skript ichida o'zgaruvchilarni o'rnat |

Overlap himoyasi:
```
*/5 * * * * flock -n /run/lock/cleanup.lock /opt/app/bin/cleanup >> /var/log/cleanup.log 2>&1
```

**Alternativ — systemd timer:**
```ini
# /etc/systemd/system/backup.timer
[Timer]
OnCalendar=*-*-* 03:00:00
Persistent=true          # server o'chiq bo'lgan vaqtdagini keyin bajaradi
[Install]
WantedBy=timers.target
```
`systemctl enable --now backup.timer`, `systemctl list-timers`. Log journald'da, job o'zi parallel ishlamaydi.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Ko'p server (HA)da bir xil crontab — job har serverda ishlaydi (ikki marta email, ikki marta to'lov). Bitta joyda yoki lock bilan.
- Skript `chmod +x` emas yoki shebang yo'q.
- `/etc/cron.d/` faylida user maydoni unutilgan — qator e'tiborsiz qoladi.

**Senior nuqta:** Cron job'ni kuzat: muvaffaqiyatli tugaganda heartbeat yuborsin (Healthchecks, Prometheus pushgateway). Eng xavfli cron xatosi — jimgina ishlamay qolish.

31438.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Avval ilova qaysi user bilan ishlashini aniqla, keyin fayl va **yo'ldagi har bir papka** huquqini tekshir (`namei -l`), egasini/huquqini minimal kerakli darajada to'g'rila (`chown`, `chmod`). Huquq to'g'ri bo'lsa ham rad etilsa — SELinux/AppArmor. `chmod 777` — yechim emas.

**Qanday tekshiriladi:**
```
process user (app) --> /var/lib/app/data.db ni ochmoqchi
  /        x kerak (kirish)
  /var     x
  /var/lib x
  /var/lib/app  x (+ yangi fayl yaratish uchun w)
  data.db  r yoki rw
  bitta "x" yo'q -> Permission denied
  hammasi ok, baribir rad -> SELinux/AppArmor, ACL, ro mount, chattr +i
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
ps -o user,pid,cmd -C myapp          # process qaysi user
systemctl show myapp -p User         # systemd servis user'i
namei -l /var/lib/app/data.db        # yo'ldagi har papka huquqi
# f: /var/lib/app/data.db
# drwxr-xr-x root root /
# drwx------ root root app      <- app user kira olmaydi
sudo -u app cat /var/lib/app/data.db # aynan shu user nomidan sinash

sudo chown -R app:app /var/lib/app
sudo chmod 750 /var/lib/app          # egasi to'liq, guruh o'qiydi
sudo chmod 640 /etc/app/env          # secret: boshqalar o'qimasin

# huquq to'g'ri, baribir rad:
sudo ausearch -m avc -ts recent      # SELinux rad etishlari
sudo restorecon -Rv /var/lib/app     # SELinux kontekstini tiklash
getfacl /var/lib/app                 # ACL
lsattr /var/lib/app/data.db          # chattr +i (immutable)?
findmnt /var/lib/app                 # ro mount emasmi
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `chmod -R 777` — har qanday user (shu jumladan buzilgan boshqa servis) yozishi va kod joylashi mumkin; xavfsizlik teshigi.
- Papkada `x` yo'q — fayl huquqi 644 bo'lsa ham ochib bo'lmaydi.
- Faylni `root` bilan yaratib (`sudo cp`) keyin ilova uni o'zgartira olmaydi — deploy skriptida egani belgilash.
- SELinux'ni `setenforce 0` bilan o'chirish — muammoni yashiradi; to'g'ri kontekst/boolean qo'y.

**Senior nuqta:** Least privilege: ilova o'z user'ida, faqat kerakli papkaga yozish huquqi bilan. systemd'da `StateDirectory=app` va `ProtectSystem=strict` + `ReadWritePaths=` — huquqlarni systemd o'zi to'g'ri yaratadi va qolgan tizimni faqat o'qish uchun qiladi.

31439.a:
**Qisqa javob:** RAM tugaganda kernel avval page cache'ni bo'shatadi, keyin anonim xotirani swap'ga chiqaradi; bu ham yetmasa **OOM killer** `oom_score` eng yuqori process'ni (odatda eng katta) o'ldiradi. Himoya: ilovalarga xotira limiti (`MemoryMax`, container limit), muhim process'larga `OOMScoreAdjust`, kichik swap, xotira monitoringi — va asosiysi, nega xotira o'sayotganini topish.

**Muammo:** cheklanmagan cache bilan ilova o'sib bordi, OOM killer PostgreSQL'ni o'ldirdi (eng katta process) — butun tizim yiqildi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
xotira bosimi
  1. page cache bo'shatiladi (arzon)
  2. anonim sahifalar -> swap (sekinlashadi, si/so > 0)
  3. swap ham tugadi / yo'q -> OOM killer
       oom_score = xotira ulushi + oom_score_adj (-1000..1000)
       eng yuqorisi SIGKILL
cgroup limiti (MemoryMax) bo'lsa: OOM faqat shu cgroup ichida -> qo'shnilar omon
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
dmesg -T | grep -iE 'killed process|out of memory'
# Out of memory: Killed process 2211 (postgres) total-vm:..., anon-rss:6.1GB
journalctl -k | grep -i oom
free -h
vmstat 1 5                        # si/so doimiy > 0 = swap thrashing
cat /proc/<pid>/oom_score
ps aux --sort=-rss | head         # eng ko'p RSS
```
```ini
# app.service — ilova o'z limitida o'lsin, server emas
[Service]
MemoryMax=2G
MemoryHigh=1.8G                    # bu yerda kernel sekinlashtira boshlaydi
# DB servisi — oxirgi navbatda o'ldirilsin
OOMScoreAdjust=-500
```
Kichik swap (VPS):
```bash
sudo fallocate -l 2G /swapfile && sudo chmod 600 /swapfile
sudo mkswap /swapfile && sudo swapon /swapfile
echo '/swapfile none swap sw 0 0' | sudo tee -a /etc/fstab
sudo sysctl vm.swappiness=10       # doimiy: /etc/sysctl.d/
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `OOMScoreAdjust=-1000` hamma narsaga — OOM killer o'ldiradigan process topolmay, tizim butunlay osilib qoladi.
- Katta swap — OOM o'rniga soatlab thrashing: server "tirik", lekin javob bermaydi. Swap kichik bo'lsin.
- Konteynerda limit yo'q — bitta container butun node'ni OOM qiladi.
- Go/Java'da runtime limitni bilmaydi: Go'da `GOMEMLIMIT`, Java'da `-XX:MaxRAMPercentage`.

**Senior nuqta:** OOM — simptom. Sababi: memory leak, cheklanmagan cache/queue, yoki concurrency'ni cheklamaslik. Heap profil (pprof, heap dump) bilan aniqla; xotira o'sishini trend sifatida alert qil, OOM bo'lgandan keyin emas.

31440.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Secret'lar kodda va git'da emas: oddiy holatda root egasidagi `600` huquqli fayl (`EnvironmentFile`) yoki systemd credentials (`LoadCredential`), yaxshiroq — markaziy secret manager (Vault, AWS Secrets Manager/SSM, GCP Secret Manager) va eng yaxshisi — qisqa muddatli, avtomatik rotate bo'ladigan credential (IAM role, Vault dynamic secrets).

**Muammo:** DB parol `config.yml`da git'ga tushgan, 40 kishi ko'radi, CI log'ida chiqqan, ishdan ketgan xodim ham biladi — va 3 yildan beri o'zgarmagan.

**Qayerdan sizib chiqadi:**
```
git tarixi       -> o'chirsang ham tarixda qoladi
ps aux           -> buyruq argumentlari (--password=...) hamma user'ga ko'rinadi
/proc/<pid>/environ -> env o'zgaruvchilar (root va o'sha user)
crash dump, debug log, xato xabari, CI log
docker inspect / image layer -> ENV va COPY qilingan .env
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
# 1. Oddiy: fayl, faqat root o'qiydi; systemd uni o'qib ilovaga beradi
sudo install -m 600 -o root -g root /dev/null /etc/app/env
# /etc/app/env:  DB_PASSWORD=...
# app.service:   EnvironmentFile=/etc/app/env
```
```ini
# 2. systemd credentials: env'da ko'rinmaydi, faqat shu servis o'qiydi
[Service]
LoadCredential=db_password:/etc/app/secrets/db_password
# ilova o'qiydi: $CREDENTIALS_DIRECTORY/db_password
# shifrlangan variant: LoadCredentialEncrypted= (systemd-creds encrypt, TPM bilan)
```
```bash
# 3. Secret manager (AWS misol): server IAM role bilan, kalit faylsiz
aws secretsmanager get-secret-value --secret-id prod/app/db --query SecretString --output text
# 4. Git'ga tushishning oldini olish
gitleaks detect --source . ; gitleaks protect --staged   # pre-commit
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Secret git'ga tushdi — tarixdan o'chirish yetmaydi (klonlar, fork, cache): darhol **rotate** qil, keyin tozala.
- `ENV DB_PASSWORD=...` Dockerfile'da — image'ni olgan har kim ko'radi.
- Hammaga bitta umumiy parol — kim ishlatganini bilib bo'lmaydi, rotate qilish qo'rqinchli.
- Ilova secret'ni log'ga yozadi (config dump, xato) — redaction.

**Senior nuqta:** Maqsad — statik secret sonini kamaytirish: cloud IAM role/workload identity, Vault dynamic DB credential (har instansiyaga soatlik), mTLS. Rotation avtomatik va muntazam bo'lsa, sizib chiqish zarari vaqt bilan cheklanadi; har secret'ga kirish audit log'da bo'lsin.

33000.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `kill PID` default **SIGTERM** (15) yuboradi — process'dan muloyim to'xtashni so'raydi: u joriy ishni tugatib, fayllarni yopib chiqa oladi. `kill -9` — **SIGKILL**: kernel process'ni darhol o'ldiradi, ushlab bo'lmaydi, tozalash bo'lmaydi. `pkill`/`killall` — nom bo'yicha signal yuboradi. Avval SIGTERM, kutish, faqat keyin SIGKILL.

**Nega `-9` oxirgi chora:** buffer flush bo'lmaydi, lock va temp fayllar qoladi, DB yozuvi yoki fayl yarim qolishi, child process'lar yetim qolishi mumkin.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
SIGTERM -> process handler: so'rovlarni tugat, ulanishlarni yop, exit 0
           (handler yo'q bo'lsa default — darhol chiqadi)
SIGKILL -> kernel: process'ni darhol olib tashlaydi (handler yo'q)
SIGHUP  -> ko'p daemon'da: config'ni qayta o'qish
SIGINT  -> Ctrl-C
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
pgrep -a myapp                 # PID va to'liq buyruq
kill 1234                      # SIGTERM
sleep 10; kill -0 1234 && echo "hali tirik"   # -0: faqat mavjudligini tekshiradi
kill -9 1234                   # oxirgi chora
pkill -f 'python worker.py'    # to'liq buyruq satri bo'yicha
kill -HUP $(pidof nginx)       # nginx: config qayta o'qish
kill -l                        # signallar ro'yxati
```
systemd servisi bo'lsa — `systemctl stop app` ishlat: u SIGTERM yuboradi, `TimeoutStopSec` kutadi, keyin SIGKILL, butun cgroup'ni (child'lar bilan) to'xtatadi.

**`kill -9` ham o'ldirmasa:**
| Holat | `ps` STAT | Sabab |
|---|---|---|
| D | `D` | uninterruptible I/O (NFS, disk) — I/O tugashini kutadi |
| Zombie | `Z` | allaqachon o'lgan; ota-process `wait()` qilmagan — otasini tuzat/restart |

```bash
ps -o pid,ppid,stat,cmd -p 1234
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `pkill -f python` — serverdagi barcha python process'larni o'ldiradi. Avval `pgrep -af` bilan ro'yxatni ko'r.
- Container'da PID 1 bo'lgan ilova SIGTERM handler'siz — signal e'tiborsiz qoladi, 10s'dan keyin SIGKILL. `tini`/`--init` yoki handler.
- Restart skriptlarida darhol `kill -9` — har deploy'da ma'lumot buzilish xavfi.

**Senior nuqta:** Graceful shutdown ilova dizaynining qismi: SIGTERM'da yangi so'rov qabul qilishni to'xtat, readiness'ni false qil, joriylarini tugat, keyin chiq. Deploy paytidagi 502'lar ko'pincha shu yo'qligidan.

33001.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Oddiy `cmd &` SSH uzilganda SIGHUP olib o'ladi. Uzoq ishlar uchun: `tmux`/`screen` (qayta ulanib natijani ko'rish mumkin), `nohup cmd &` (oddiy, lekin boshqaruv yo'q) yoki eng ishonchlisi `systemd-run` (log journald'da, status bor, SSH'ga bog'liq emas).

**Muammo:** 3 soatlik DB migratsiya, 40-daqiqada Wi-Fi uzildi — process o'ldi, migratsiya yarim holatda qoldi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
SSH sessiya --> bash --> cmd
SSH uzildi  --> SIGHUP bash'ga --> barcha child'larga --> cmd o'ladi

tmux:   tmux server (SSH'dan mustaqil) --> bash --> cmd   (SSH uzilsa ham yashaydi)
systemd-run: PID 1 (systemd) --> cmd (sessiyaga umuman bog'liq emas)
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
# 1. tmux (interaktiv, keyin qaytib ko'rish)
tmux new -s migrate
./migrate.sh
# Ctrl-b d   -> detach, SSH yopilsa bo'ladi
tmux ls
tmux attach -t migrate

# 2. nohup (tez, oddiy)
nohup ./backup.sh > backup.log 2>&1 &
tail -f backup.log

# 3. systemd-run (eng ishonchli)
sudo systemd-run --unit=oneoff-backup --property=User=app /opt/backup.sh
systemctl status oneoff-backup
journalctl -u oneoff-backup -f
```

| Usul | Qayta ulanish | Log | Reboot'dan keyin |
|---|---|---|---|
| `&` | yo'q | terminal | yo'q |
| `nohup` | yo'q | fayl | yo'q |
| `tmux` | ha | ekranda | yo'q |
| `systemd-run` | `journalctl` | journald | yo'q (lekin holat ko'rinadi) |

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `nohup` chiqishni yo'naltirmasang `nohup.out` faylga yozadi — qayerga ketganini unutish oson.
- tmux sessiyasi root bilan ochilgan, boshqa admin uni topmaydi — sessiya nomlarini aniq qo'y.
- Ba'zi tizimlarda systemd-logind `KillUserProcesses=yes` — logout'da tmux ham o'ladi; `loginctl enable-linger user`.

**Senior nuqta:** Uzoq operatsiya qayta boshlanadigan (idempotent, checkpoint bilan) bo'lsin — process baribir o'lishi mumkin. Muhim bir martalik ishlar uchun alohida job (K8s Job, CI pipeline) — log va audit saqlanadi.

33002.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `tail -f` — log'ni jonli kuzatish, `grep` — kerakli qatorlarni filtrlash, `less` — katta faylni sahifalab ko'rish va qidirish, `awk` — ustunlar bo'yicha ajratib hisoblash. Top IP: `awk '{print $1}' access.log | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head`.

**Nega pipe:** har vosita bitta ishni qiladi; ularni `|` bilan ulab, millionlab qatordan bir necha soniyada javob olasan.

**Pipeline qanday ishlaydi:**
```
access.log
  | awk '{print $1}'   -> faqat 1-ustun (IP)
  | sort               -> bir xil IP'lar yonma-yon
  | uniq -c            -> har biriga son:  523 1.2.3.4
  | sort -rn           -> son bo'yicha kamayish
  | head               -> top 10
```

Nginx combined format ustunlari: `$1` IP, `$4` vaqt, `$7` URL, `$9` status, `$10` hajm.

**Amalda:**
```bash
tail -f /var/log/nginx/access.log
tail -n 200 /var/log/app/app.log
grep -i error app.log | tail -50
grep -c ' 500 ' access.log                    # nechta 500
grep -C 3 'panic' app.log                     # atrofidagi 3 qator bilan

awk '{print $1}' access.log | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head        # top IP
awk '$9 >= 500 {print $7}' access.log | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head   # 5xx bergan URL
awk '$4 ~ /03\/Oct\/2026:14/' access.log | wc -l                      # 14:00 soatdagi so'rovlar

zgrep 'timeout' /var/log/app/*.gz             # siqilgan log'larda
journalctl -u app --since today | grep -i panic
```
`less` ichida: `/matn` qidirish, `n` keyingi, `N` oldingi, `G` oxiri, `g` boshi, `F` follow (tail -f kabi), `q` chiqish.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `grep ' 500 '` URL yoki hajm ustunidagi 500 ga ham mos keladi — aniq ustun uchun `awk '$9==500'`.
- `uniq` faqat yonma-yon takrorlarni sanaydi — oldin `sort` shart.
- Katta faylda `cat file | grep` keraksiz; `grep` faylni o'zi o'qiydi. Juda katta log'da `less` faylni xotiraga yuklamaydi, `vim` yuklaydi.
- LB ortida `$1` — LB IP'si; real IP `X-Forwarded-For`da (log formatini sozla).

**Senior nuqta:** Bu — server'dagi favqulodda tahlil. Muntazam savollar (top IP, 5xx ulushi) uchun structured (JSON) log va markaziy tizim (Loki, Elasticsearch) — so'rovni barcha serverlar bo'yicha bir joyda berasan.

33003.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `apt update` — faqat repozitoriylardagi paketlar **ro'yxatini** (indeksini) yangilaydi, hech narsa o'rnatmaydi. `apt upgrade` — o'rnatilgan paketlarni shu ro'yxat bo'yicha yangi versiyaga ko'taradi (hech narsani o'chirmaydi). `apt full-upgrade` — dependency uchun kerak bo'lsa paket o'chirishi ham mumkin. RHEL oilasida `dnf check-update` / `dnf upgrade`.

**Nega ikki qadam:** avval "nima yangi bor"ni bilish (update), keyin qaror qilib o'rnatish (upgrade). Indeks eskirsa, `apt install` eski versiyani yoki 404 xatoni beradi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
apt update   : repo (deb.debian.org) --Packages indeks--> /var/lib/apt/lists/
apt upgrade  : indeks vs o'rnatilgan --> yangi .deb'larni yuklab o'rnatadi
               imzo tekshiriladi (repo GPG kaliti)
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
sudo apt update
apt list --upgradable              # nima yangilanadi
sudo apt upgrade                   # yangilash
sudo apt full-upgrade              # dependency o'zgarishi bilan
sudo apt install nginx=1.24.*      # aniq versiya
apt-cache policy nginx             # mavjud versiyalar va manbasi
sudo apt-mark hold postgresql-16   # avtomatik yangilanishdan saqlash
sudo apt autoremove                # keraksiz dependency'lar

# RHEL / Rocky / Alma
sudo dnf check-update
sudo dnf upgrade --security        # faqat xavfsizlik yangilanishlari
sudo dnf history                   # nima qachon o'zgardi (undo ham bor)

# reboot kerakmi?
[ -f /var/run/reboot-required ] && cat /var/run/reboot-required   # Debian/Ubuntu
sudo needs-restarting -r                                          # RHEL
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- DB, kernel, container runtime'ni nazoratsiz avtomatik yangilash — kutilmagan restart va downtime. Muhim paketlarni `hold` qil, staging'da sinab yangila.
- Kernel yangilandi, reboot qilinmadi — zaiflik hali ham yamalmagan holatda.
- Noma'lum PPA/repo qo'shish — supply chain xavfi; faqat ishonchli, imzolangan repolar.
- Ikki terminalda bir vaqtda apt — `Could not get lock /var/lib/dpkg/lock` (lock faylni o'chirma, boshqa process tugashini kut).

**Senior nuqta:** Xavfsizlik yangilanishlari avtomatik (`unattended-upgrades` faqat security), qolganlari rejali va bosqichli (staging -> canary -> prod). Immutable yondashuvda serverni yangilamaysan — yangilangan image'dan qayta yaratasan.

33004.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Bosqichma-bosqich: domen IP'ga resolve bo'ladimi (`dig +short`), IP to'g'rimi, turli resolver'lar bir xil javob beradimi (`dig @8.8.8.8`), authoritative server nima deydi (`dig +trace`), lokal tizim nima ko'radi (`getent hosts`). Keyin DNS'ni chetlab o'tib serverni to'g'ridan tekshir (`curl --resolve`) — muammo DNS'dami yoki serverda, shu ajratadi.

**Qanday fikrlash:**
```
dig +short domen
   bo'sh / NXDOMAIN  -> yozuv yo'q yoki domen/NS muammo  -> dig +trace, registrar
   eski IP           -> TTL cache, yoki noto'g'ri zona     -> dig @authoritative
   to'g'ri IP        -> DNS ok -> curl --resolve bilan server/TLS/firewall'ni tekshir
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
dig +short example.com
dig example.com A @8.8.8.8            # Google resolver
dig example.com A @1.1.1.1            # Cloudflare resolver — farq bormi
dig +trace example.com                # root -> .com -> authoritative, kim nima deydi
dig NS example.com +short             # qaysi DNS provayder
dig example.com A @ns1.provider.com   # to'g'ridan authoritative'dan (cache'siz)
getent hosts example.com              # ilova ko'radigan natija (/etc/hosts bilan)
resolvectl status                     # server qaysi DNS'ni ishlatadi
resolvectl flush-caches               # lokal cache tozalash

curl -v --resolve example.com:443:203.0.113.10 https://example.com   # DNS'siz sinash
```
O'qish: `status: NXDOMAIN` — bunday nom yo'q; `SERVFAIL` — resolver javob ololmadi (ko'pincha DNSSEC yoki NS ishlamaydi); `ANSWER: 0` va `NOERROR` — nom bor, lekin bu tipdagi yozuv yo'q.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Yozuv o'zgargan, lekin eski IP TTL tugaguncha resolver'lar cache'ida. Ko'chirishdan bir kun oldin TTL'ni 300s ga tushir.
- Registrar'da NS boshqa provayderga ko'rsatilgan — yozuvni noto'g'ri panelda tahrirlayapsan.
- `/etc/hosts`dagi eski yozuv — `dig` to'g'ri, ilova noto'g'ri IP'ga boradi.
- `www` uchun yozuv bor, apex (`example.com`) uchun yo'q (yoki aksincha).

**Senior nuqta:** DNS'ni kod sifatida boshqar (Terraform/OctoDNS) — kim, qachon, nima o'zgartirganini tarix ko'rsatadi. Tashqi synthetic monitoring bir necha resolver orqali tekshirsin; ichki cache muammoni yashirishi mumkin.

33005.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Zanjirni ichkaridan tashqariga tekshir: ilova ishlayaptimi -> qaysi manzilda tinglaydi (`ss -tlnp`: `127.0.0.1` yoki `0.0.0.0`) -> serverning o'zida `curl` javob beradimi -> host firewall (`ufw`/`nft`) -> cloud security group -> DNS va brauzer (HTTPS, sertifikat). Qaysi qadamda sinsa, muammo o'sha qatlamda.

**Qanday fikrlash:**
```
brauzer --> DNS --> internet --> cloud SG/NACL --> host firewall --> nginx :443 --> app :8080
   5          4                      3                2              1b             1a
1a: curl localhost:8080 ishlaydimi?
1b: curl localhost (nginx orqali)?
2 : ufw/nft port ochiqmi?
3 : SG inbound 443 0.0.0.0/0 bormi?
4 : dig domen -> to'g'ri IP?
5 : HTTPS/sertifikat/redirect loop?
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
systemctl status app
ss -tlnp | grep -E '8080|443|80'
# LISTEN 127.0.0.1:8080  users:(("app",pid=900))   <- faqat lokal, tashqaridan ko'rinmaydi
# LISTEN 0.0.0.0:443     users:(("nginx",...))
curl -v http://127.0.0.1:8080/health          # ilovaning o'zi
curl -vk https://127.0.0.1/ -H 'Host: example.com'   # nginx orqali
sudo ufw status verbose
sudo nft list ruleset | less
# boshqa mashinadan:
nc -vz <public-ip> 443                        # port tashqaridan ochiqmi
curl -v https://example.com
```

**Tipik sabablar:**
| Belgi | Sabab |
|---|---|
| lokal curl ok, tashqaridan timeout | firewall yoki security group |
| tashqaridan `Connection refused` | port ochiq, lekin u yerda hech kim tinglamayapti |
| `127.0.0.1:8080` tinglaydi | ilova faqat lokal — nginx orqali chiqar |
| 502 | nginx bor, ilova javob bermaydi |
| brauzerda sertifikat xatosi | domen/zanjir/muddat |

**Tuzoqlar:**
- "Port ochiq" deb `ss`ga qarash — bu faqat process tinglayotganini ko'rsatadi, firewall'ni emas.
- Docker `-p 8080:8080` ufw qoidalarini aylanib o'tadi — port kutilmaganda internetga ochiladi.
- Timeout (paket tashlandi — firewall) va refused (javob keldi — tinglovchi yo'q) farqini o'qishni bil.

**Senior nuqta:** Ilovani to'g'ridan internetga ochma: ilova `127.0.0.1`da, tashqariga faqat nginx/LB 443. Security group'larni kodda (Terraform) saqla — "kim bu portni ochdi?" savoli tarixdan javob topadi.

33006.a:
**Qisqa javob:** **502 Bad Gateway** — nginx upstream'dan yaroqli javob ololmadi (ulanish rad etildi, uzildi, socket yo'q). **504 Gateway Timeout** — upstream'ga ulandi, ammo `proxy_read_timeout` ichida javob kelmadi. Diagnostika: `error.log`dagi aniq xabar -> ilova holati va porti -> ilovaga nginx'siz `curl` -> latency o'lchash.

**Qanday ajratiladi:**
```
nginx --> app
  ulanish yo'q / reset / socket huquqi   -> 502  (mavjudlik muammosi)
  ulandi, javob kechikdi (> 60s)          -> 504  (latency muammosi)
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
sudo tail -f /var/log/nginx/error.log
# 502: connect() failed (111: Connection refused) while connecting to upstream
# 502: upstream prematurely closed connection while reading response header
# 502: connect() to unix:/run/app.sock failed (13: Permission denied)
# 504: upstream timed out (110: Connection timed out) while reading response header

systemctl status app; journalctl -u app -n 50   # app crash/restart bo'lyaptimi
ss -tlnp | grep 8080                             # tinglayaptimi, qaysi manzilda
curl -sv http://127.0.0.1:8080/healthz
curl -o /dev/null -s -w '%{time_total}\n' http://127.0.0.1:8080/slow
```
Access log'ga qo'sh: `$upstream_addr $upstream_status $upstream_response_time` — qaysi endpoint sekin.

**502 sabablari:**
- App o'chgan yoki restart bo'lyapti (crash loop, OOM).
- Noto'g'ri port/socket yo'li, unix socket huquqi.
- SELinux: `setsebool -P httpd_can_network_connect 1`.
- App keepalive timeout'i nginx'nikidan qisqa — app yopgan ulanishga nginx yozadi.

**504 sabablari:** sekin DB query, tashqi API'da timeout yo'q, worker pool to'lgan, lock kutish.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- 504'ni `proxy_read_timeout 300s` bilan "yopish" — muammo yashiriladi, worker'lar band bo'ladi, keyin hammasi sekinlashadi. Avval sekin endpoint'ni tuzat (query plan, timeout'lar).
- Faqat nginx log'iga qarash — app log'idagi panic/OOM sababni ko'rsatadi.
- Deploy paytidagi qisqa 502'larni e'tiborsiz qoldirish.

**Senior nuqta:** Deploy'dagi 502'lar — graceful shutdown va readiness check yo'qligi belgisi: app SIGTERM'da yangi so'rov olishni to'xtatsin, LB uni chiqarsin, keyin o'lsin. 502 va 504 ni alohida metrika va alert qil.

33007.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Internetga ochiq SSH'ga avtomatik botlar doimo parol tanlaydi — bu normal fon. Asosiy himoya — parol bilan kirishni butunlay o'chirish (faqat kalit), root login yo'q, ruxsat berilgan user'lar ro'yxati. **fail2ban** log'ni o'qib, ko'p xato qilgan IP'ni vaqtincha bloklaydi — shovqin va resurs sarfini kamaytiradi. Eng yaxshisi — SSH'ni internetga umuman ochmaslik (VPN, bastion, SSM).

**Qanday ishlaydi (fail2ban):**
```
/var/log/auth.log (yoki journald)
   "Failed password for root from 1.2.3.4"
        v  filter (regex) sanaydi
   findtime=10m ichida maxretry=5 dan oshdi
        v  action
   nftables/iptables: 1.2.3.4 -> DROP (bantime=1h)
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
# kim urinmoqda
grep 'Failed password' /var/log/auth.log | awk '{print $(NF-3)}' | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head
journalctl -u ssh --since today | grep -c 'Failed'
```
```ini
# /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/hardening.conf
PasswordAuthentication no
KbdInteractiveAuthentication no
PermitRootLogin no
AllowUsers deploy
MaxAuthTries 3
```
```bash
sudo sshd -t && sudo systemctl reload ssh     # ikkinchi terminalda kirib sinab ko'r!
```
```ini
# /etc/fail2ban/jail.local
[sshd]
enabled  = true
backend  = systemd
maxretry = 5
findtime = 10m
bantime  = 1h
bantime.increment = true     # takrorlovchilarga uzunroq ban
ignoreip = 127.0.0.1/8 10.0.0.0/8
```
```bash
sudo systemctl enable --now fail2ban
sudo fail2ban-client status sshd             # bloklangan IP'lar
sudo fail2ban-client set sshd unbanip 1.2.3.4
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Kalit qo'shilmasdan `PasswordAuthentication no` qilish va sessiyani yopish — o'zingni bloklaysan. Avval kalit bilan kirishni sina.
- fail2ban parol o'chirilgan bo'lsa ham foydali, lekin u asosiy himoya emas — taqsimlangan botnet har IP'dan 2 marta uradi.
- Port 22'ni o'zgartirish — log shovqinini kamaytiradi, xavfsizlik emas.
- Ofis IP'si `ignoreip`da yo'q — xato yozgan admin bloklanadi.

**Senior nuqta:** Eng kuchli nazorat — SSH internetda yo'q: Tailscale/WireGuard, bastion (faqat ma'lum IP'lardan) yoki AWS SSM Session Manager (port ochilmaydi, IAM bilan, sessiyalar audit qilinadi). Qo'shimcha: SSH sertifikatlari yoki MFA, va muvaffaqiyatli login'larni ham alert'ga ulash.

33008.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Tuzatish: `certbot renew` (yoki `--force-renewal`) bilan sertifikatni yangilash va `systemctl reload nginx` — server yangi faylni o'qishi kerak. Keyin nega avtomatik yangilanmaganini topish (timer o'chiq, 80-port yopiq, DNS token eskirgan, reload hook yo'q). Oldini olish: avtomatik renew + deploy hook + tashqaridan muddat monitoringi.

**Nega bo'ladi:**
```
certbot.timer (kuniga 2 marta) --> certbot renew
    x timer disabled / server qayta qurilgan
    x HTTP-01: 80-port yopilgan yoki redirect challenge'ni buzgan
    x DNS-01: API token muddati o'tgan
    ok yangilandi, lekin nginx reload qilinmadi -> eski sertifikat xotirada
```

**Amalda (tuzatish):**
```bash
sudo certbot certificates                       # qaysi domen, qachon tugaydi
sudo certbot renew --dry-run                    # nega yiqilyapti — xabarni o'qi
sudo certbot renew --deploy-hook 'systemctl reload nginx'
sudo nginx -t && sudo systemctl reload nginx

# server haqiqatan qaysi sertifikatni beryapti (tashqaridan)
echo | openssl s_client -connect example.com:443 -servername example.com 2>/dev/null \
  | openssl x509 -noout -dates -subject
# notAfter=Dec 30 12:00:00 2026 GMT
```
Log: `/var/log/letsencrypt/letsencrypt.log`.

**Oldini olish:**
```bash
systemctl list-timers | grep certbot          # timer bormi
sudo systemctl enable --now certbot.timer
# doimiy deploy hook
echo -e '#!/bin/sh\nsystemctl reload nginx' | sudo tee /etc/letsencrypt/renewal-hooks/deploy/reload-nginx.sh
sudo chmod +x /etc/letsencrypt/renewal-hooks/deploy/reload-nginx.sh
```
Monitoring: blackbox_exporter `probe_ssl_earliest_cert_expiry - time() < 14*86400` -> alert. 80-port yopiq yoki wildcard bo'lsa — DNS-01.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Fayl yangilangan, lekin reload yo'q — eng ko'p uchraydigan sabab; `certbot certificates` "VALID" deydi, brauzer esa muddati o'tgan deydi.
- Ko'p server/LB ortida — sertifikat bitta serverda yangilandi, boshqalarida eski.
- Muddatni ichkaridan (fayl bo'yicha) tekshirish — tashqariga aslida nima berilayotganini ko'rsatmaydi.

**Senior nuqta:** Sertifikat muddatlari qisqarib bormoqda (CA/Browser Forum 2029 yilgacha bosqichma-bosqich 47 kungacha), ya'ni qo'lda boshqarish imkonsiz. Markazlashtir (LB/ACM, cert-manager) va tashqi monitoring'ni majburiy qil — expiry incident'i 100% oldini olsa bo'ladigan muammo.

33009.a:
**Qisqa javob:** So'rovni bosqichlarga ajrat: DNS, TCP ulanish, TLS, server javobi (`curl -w` vaqtlari). Qaysi bosqich sekin bo'lsa, o'sha qatlamni chuqur tekshir: DNS — resolver; TCP — yo'l, packet loss (`mtr`), firewall/conntrack, ephemeral port; TLS — handshake, OCSP; TTFB — tashqi API o'zi sekin. Uzilishlar uchun `tcpdump` bilan haqiqiy paketlarni ko'r.

**Qanday fikrlash:**
```
curl -w:  dns  -> tcp  -> tls  -> ttfb  -> total
          |       |       |       |
       resolver  yo'l/   handshake  server tomoni
       timeout   SYN drop  CPU/OCSP   (bizniki emas, timeout qo'y)
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
curl -o /dev/null -s -w 'dns=%{time_namelookup} tcp=%{time_connect} tls=%{time_appconnect} ttfb=%{time_starttransfer} total=%{time_total}\n' https://api.example.com
# dns=5.012 tcp=5.040 ...   <- DNS 5s: resolver timeout (birinchi nameserver o'lik)

mtr -rwc 50 api.example.com            # loss qaysi hop'dan boshlanadi
ss -tan state syn-sent                 # javobsiz ulanish urinishlari
ss -s                                  # TIME-WAIT soni
sysctl net.ipv4.ip_local_port_range    # ephemeral port diapazoni
conntrack -S 2>/dev/null | grep -i drop; dmesg | grep -i 'nf_conntrack: table full'
sudo tcpdump -i any -nn host 1.2.3.4 and port 443 -w cap.pcap   # keyin Wireshark
getent ahosts api.example.com          # IPv4 va IPv6 manzillar
curl -4 -v https://api.example.com     # faqat IPv4 bilan solishtir
```

**Tipik sabablar:**
| Belgi | Sabab |
|---|---|
| `dns` ~5s | `resolv.conf`dagi birinchi DNS javob bermaydi |
| `tcp` sekin, ba'zan timeout | packet loss, SYN drop, conntrack to'lgan |
| ko'p TIME-WAIT, `cannot assign requested address` | connection reuse yo'q, ephemeral port tugagan |
| birinchi urinish sekin, `-4` tez | AAAA bor, IPv6 marshrut yo'q |
| `ttfb` katta | tashqi servis sekin |
| cloud'da kunduzi uzilish | NAT gateway port/ulanish limiti |

**Tuzoqlar:**
- HTTP client'da timeout yo'q — tashqi API osilsa goroutine/thread'lar to'planib ilova o'ladi.
- Har so'rovga yangi ulanish (keepalive yo'q) — TLS handshake narxi va port tugashi.
- Retry'lar backoff'siz — sekin servisni yanada bosib qo'yadi (retry storm).

**Senior nuqta:** Tashqi bog'liqlik uchun: connect/read timeout, connection pool, jitter'li exponential backoff, circuit breaker va per-dependency metrika (latency p99, xato ulushi). Shunda "tarmoq sekin" degan taxmin o'rniga dashboard qaysi qatlam ekanini ko'rsatadi.

33010.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Fayl tizimida ikki xil resurs bor: **bloklar** (hajm, `df -h`) va **inode**'lar (har fayl uchun metadata yozuvi, `df -i`). Millionlab mayda fayl (session, cache, mail queue) inode'larni tugatadi — joy bo'lsa ham yangi fayl yaratib bo'lmaydi. Boshqa sabablar: o'chirilgan, lekin hali ochiq fayllar, quota, to'lgan tmpfs, root uchun rezerv bloklar.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
fayl nomi (papka yozuvi) --> inode #1234 (egasi, huquq, hajm, bloklar ro'yxati)
                                 --> data bloklari
hardlink: ikki nom -> bitta inode (link count=2), fayl oxirgi nom o'chganda o'chadi
ochiq fayl: nom o'chirildi, lekin process fd ushlab tursa -> bloklar bo'shamaydi
ext4: inode soni mkfs paytida belgilanadi, keyin oshirib bo'lmaydi
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
df -h /var        # Use% 40%  -> joy bor
df -i /var        # IUse% 100% -> inode tugagan
# qaysi papkada eng ko'p fayl
sudo find /var -xdev -type f | cut -d/ -f2-4 | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head
# yoki
for d in /var/*; do echo "$(sudo find "$d" -xdev | wc -l) $d"; done | sort -n | tail

sudo find /var/lib/php/sessions -type f -mmin +1440 -delete   # eski session'lar

# o'chirilgan, lekin ochiq fayllar (df bilan du mos kelmasa)
sudo lsof +L1
# app 900 ... /var/log/app.log (deleted)   -> ilovani restart/reopen qil
```
Boshqa tekshiruvlar:
```bash
quota -s; repquota -a           # user quota
df -h /tmp                      # tmpfs to'lganmi
sudo tune2fs -l /dev/sda1 | grep -i 'reserved block'   # ext4 5% rezerv (faqat root)
docker system df                # overlay/image'lar
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Millionlab faylli papkada `rm *` — "Argument list too long"; `find ... -delete` ishlat.
- Katta log faylni `rm` qilish — ilova uni ochiq tutsa joy bo'shamaydi; `: > file` (truncate) yoki reopen.
- Yangi disk yaratganda inode zichligi (`mkfs.ext4 -i`) mayda fayllar uchun mos emas; XFS inode'larni dinamik ajratadi.

**Senior nuqta:** Monitoringda faqat disk `%` emas, inode `%` ham bo'lsin (`node_filesystem_files_free`). Millionlab mayda fayl — dizayn belgisi: session'ni Redis'ga, fayllarni obyekt storage'ga ko'chir, cleanup job'ni majburiy qil.

33011.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Docker default'da `json-file` log driver'i **limitsiz** yozadi — `/var/lib/docker/containers/*/*-json.log` diskni to'ldiradi; `daemon.json`da `max-size`/`max-file` qo'yiladi. Restart policy (`--restart unless-stopped`) container crash yoki reboot'dan keyin qayta ko'tarilishini ta'minlaydi. Resurs limitlari (`--memory`, `--cpus`) bitta container butun serverni yiqitishining oldini oladi.

**Muammo:** ilova sekundiga yuzlab log qatori yozadi — bir haftada 80 GB json log, disk 100%, Docker va boshqa servislar to'xtadi.

**Amalda:**
```json
// /etc/docker/daemon.json
{
  "log-driver": "json-file",
  "log-opts": { "max-size": "50m", "max-file": "3" },
  "live-restore": true
}
```
```bash
sudo systemctl restart docker             # faqat YANGI yaratilgan container'larga ta'sir qiladi
du -sh /var/lib/docker/containers/*/*-json.log | sort -h | tail
docker inspect -f '{{.HostConfig.LogConfig}}' app

docker run -d --name app \
  --restart unless-stopped \
  --memory 512m --cpus 1 --pids-limit 200 \
  --read-only --tmpfs /tmp \
  --user 10001:10001 \
  -p 127.0.0.1:8080:8080 \
  registry.example.com/app:1.4.2

docker stats --no-stream                  # CPU/RAM ishlatilishi
docker system df                          # image/volume/cache hajmi
docker image prune -a --filter until=168h # 7 kundan eski ishlatilmagan image'lar
```

| Restart policy | Ma'nosi |
|---|---|
| `no` | hech qachon (default) |
| `on-failure[:5]` | exit code != 0 bo'lsa |
| `unless-stopped` | har doim, qo'lda to'xtatilgan bo'lmasa |
| `always` | har doim, qo'lda to'xtatilsa ham daemon restart'da ko'tariladi |

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `daemon.json` o'zgargach eski container'lar eski sozlamada qoladi — ularni qayta yaratish kerak.
- `-p 8080:8080` Docker iptables qoidalari orqali ufw'ni aylanib o'tadi — port internetga ochiladi. `127.0.0.1:` bilan bog'la, tashqariga nginx orqali.
- `latest` tag bilan deploy — qaysi versiya ishlayotgani noma'lum, rollback qiyin; aniq tag yoki digest.
- Memory limitsiz container'da OOM — kernel boshqa servislarni o'ldirishi mumkin.

**Senior nuqta:** Bitta serverda bir nechta container'ni Docker Compose bilan deklarativ boshqar (log, limit, restart — faylda, git'da). Container root bo'lmagan user bilan, read-only rootfs bilan ishlasin; Docker socket'ini hech qachon container'ga ulama — bu host'ga root huquqi demak.

33012.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Yo'q — "backup bor" faqat fayl borligini bildiradi. Tiklay olishni isbotlash uchun: butunlikni avtomatik tekshirish (`restic check`, `pg_restore -l`), muntazam **to'liq restore** alohida muhitga + ilova smoke test + vaqtni o'lchash (RTO), va backup'ning o'zini buzg'unchi/ransomware'dan himoya qilish (immutable, alohida credential).

**Real holatlar:** backup skripti 3 oydan beri jimgina bo'sh fayl yozgan; dump bor, lekin shifrlash kaliti yo'qolgan; tiklash 2 kun oladi, biznes esa 4 soat kutadi.

**Tekshiruv darajalari:**
```
1. backup ishladimi?         -> exit code, oxirgi muvaffaqiyat vaqti, hajm (keskin kichraydimi)
2. fayl butunmi?             -> checksum / restic check / pg_restore -l
3. tiklab bo'ladimi?         -> alohida serverga restore
4. ilova ishlaydimi?         -> smoke test, row count, oxirgi yozuv sanasi
5. qancha vaqt oldi?         -> RTO bilan solishtir
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
restic -r s3:s3.amazonaws.com/bkt backup /var/lib/app --tag daily
restic -r s3:s3.amazonaws.com/bkt snapshots
restic -r s3:s3.amazonaws.com/bkt check --read-data-subset=5%   # haqiqiy data'ni ham o'qiydi
restic -r s3:s3.amazonaws.com/bkt restore latest --target /tmp/restore-test

# PostgreSQL
pg_dump -Fc app > app.dump && pg_restore -l app.dump > /dev/null && echo "o'qiladi"
createdb restore_test && time pg_restore -d restore_test -j 4 app.dump
psql restore_test -c "select count(*), max(created_at) from orders;"   # mantiqiy tekshiruv
```
Monitoring: "oxirgi muvaffaqiyatli backup > 26 soat oldin" -> alert; backup hajmi oldingisidan 50% kichik -> alert.

**Himoya (ransomware / insider):**
- S3 Object Lock (compliance mode) yoki append-only repo — yozish bor, o'chirish yo'q.
- Backup'ni server credential'idan alohida akkaunt/role yozsin; prod admin'i backup'ni o'chira olmasin.
- Shifrlash kaliti backup bilan bir joyda emas (va kalitning o'z backup'i bor).

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Ishlab turgan DB fayllarini `tar`/`rsync` qilish — mos kelmaydigan backup; dump, snapshot yoki WAL archiving ishlat.
- Faqat fayl tekshiriladi, restore hech qachon — muammo incident kuni chiqadi.
- Restore test qo'lda — vaqt o'tib to'xtaydi. Avtomatlashtir (haftalik job).

**Senior nuqta:** Restore'ni muntazam, avtomatik, natijasi metrikada bo'ladigan jarayon qil va yiliga kamida bir marta jamoa bilan DR drill o'tkaz. Backup strategiyasi RPO/RTO dan kelib chiqadi, vositadan emas.

33013.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Root bilan doimiy ishlash — har bir xato buyruq (yoki buzilgan sessiya) butun tizimga ta'sir qiladi va kim nima qilgani ajralmaydi. `sudo` — har bir user o'z nomidan, faqat kerakli buyruqlarni root huquqi bilan bajaradi va har ishlatish log'ga yoziladi. Cheklash: `/etc/sudoers.d/` faylida aniq buyruqlar ro'yxati, `visudo` bilan tahrir.

**Nega muhim (himoya):** least privilege — deploy user'iga faqat servisni restart qilish kerak, butun tizim emas. Audit — incident'da "kim qildi?" savoliga javob.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
deploy$ sudo systemctl restart app
   -> sudoers: deploy ga shu buyruq ruxsat etilganmi?
        ha  -> root sifatida bajaradi, journald/auth.log'ga yozadi (user, buyruq, vaqt)
        yo'q -> "is not allowed to execute" + log
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
sudo visudo -f /etc/sudoers.d/deploy       # sintaksisni tekshirib saqlaydi
```
```
# /etc/sudoers.d/deploy
deploy ALL=(root) NOPASSWD: /usr/bin/systemctl restart app, /usr/bin/systemctl status app
%ops   ALL=(ALL) ALL                       # ops guruhi — parol bilan to'liq
Defaults:deploy !requiretty
Defaults logfile=/var/log/sudo.log
Defaults use_pty
```
```bash
sudo -l -U deploy                  # deploy nima qila oladi
journalctl _COMM=sudo --since today
sudo grep -r NOPASSWD /etc/sudoers /etc/sudoers.d/   # audit
sudoedit /etc/app/config.yml       # muharrirni root bilan emas, user sifatida ishlatadi
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `sudo vim`, `less`, `find`, `awk`, `tar` ga ruxsat — ichidan shell ochish mumkin (`:!sh`, `-exec`). Fayl tahriri uchun `sudoedit`.
- Wildcard: `/usr/bin/systemctl *` — istalgan servisni, shu jumladan o'z yaratgan unit'ini ishga tushirish.
- Skript yo'li ruxsat berilgan, lekin skript faylini user o'zi o'zgartira oladi — root egasi bo'lsin, yozish huquqisiz.
- `sudo su -` / `sudo -i` umumiy ishlatilsa — keyingi buyruqlar alohida log'ga tushmaydi.
- `/etc/sudoers`ni oddiy muharrir bilan buzish — hech kim sudo qila olmaydi; har doim `visudo`.

**Senior nuqta:** Doimiy root o'rniga just-in-time kirish (vaqtinchalik huquq, tasdiq bilan) va markaziy audit (sudo log -> SIEM). Ko'p serverda sudoers'ni qo'lda emas, Ansible/IdM (FreeIPA) orqali boshqar.

33014.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Reboot'dan keyin ishlamay qolish deyarli doim **runtime o'zgarish persistent qilinmaganidan**: servis `enable` qilinmagan, mount `/etc/fstab`da yo'q yoki noto'g'ri, `sysctl -w`/`ip addr add` faqat xotirada edi, yoki boot tartibi (servis disk/tarmoq tayyor bo'lmasdan start). Tekshiruv: `systemctl --failed`, `journalctl -b`, `systemctl is-enabled`, `findmnt --verify`.

**Qanday fikrlash:**
```
reboot
  |-- mount ishlamadi?   -> fstab (UUID o'zgardimi, nofail, _netdev)
  |-- servis start emas? -> is-enabled? journalctl -b -u app
  |-- start bo'ldi, yiqildi? -> bog'liqlik (DB/disk/network hali tayyor emas)
  |-- ishlaydi, lekin boshqacha? -> sysctl/route/iptables runtime'da edi
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
systemctl --failed
systemctl is-enabled app            # disabled -> sudo systemctl enable app
journalctl -b -u app                # joriy boot'dagi log
journalctl -b -1 -p err             # oldingi boot xatolari
systemd-analyze critical-chain app.service   # nimani kutdi, qancha vaqt
findmnt --verify                    # fstab xatolarini tekshiradi
sudo mount -a                       # fstab'ni reboot'siz sinash
lsblk -f                            # UUID'lar (fstab bilan solishtir)
```
Persistent joylar:
| Runtime buyruq | Doimiy joy |
|---|---|
| `systemctl start` | `systemctl enable` |
| `mount` | `/etc/fstab` yoki `.mount` unit |
| `sysctl -w` | `/etc/sysctl.d/*.conf` |
| `ip addr/route add` | netplan / NetworkManager / systemd-networkd |
| `iptables -A` | nftables config / `netfilter-persistent` |
| `ulimit` | unit `Limit*` / `limits.conf` |

Tarmoq diski uchun fstab: `UUID=... /data ext4 defaults,nofail,_netdev 0 2`. Servis disk/tarmoqni kutsin:
```ini
[Unit]
After=network-online.target data.mount
Wants=network-online.target
RequiresMountsFor=/data
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- fstab'da `/dev/sdb1` — reboot'da disk nomi o'zgarishi mumkin; UUID ishlat.
- fstab xatosi + `nofail` yo'q — server emergency mode'da, cloud'da konsolsiz yetib bo'lmaydi.
- Servis `After=network.target` bilan tarmoq hali IP olmasidan start bo'ladi.

**Senior nuqta:** Rejali reboot'ni muntazam qil (masalan kernel yangilanishida) — yashirin runtime holat erta topiladi. Undan ham yaxshisi — server konfiguratsiyasi to'liq kodda (Ansible/image), shunda reboot va qayta yaratish bir xil natija beradi.

33015.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Avval process holatini aniqla (`/proc/<pid>/status`, `wchan`): CPU yeyaptimi, uxlayaptimi, D state'dami. `strace` — process qaysi syscall'da turganini ko'rsatadi (masalan `connect` yoki `futex`), `lsof` — qaysi fayl va socket'lar ochiq, `tcpdump` — tarmoqda haqiqatan nima bo'layapti. Go/Java uchun til darajasidagi dump (goroutine/thread stack) eng ko'p ma'lumot beradi.

**Qanday fikrlash:**
```
"osilib qoldi"
  top: CPU 100%?   -> busy loop: perf top / pprof CPU
  CPU 0%           -> nimanidir kutyapti:
      State D      -> disk/NFS I/O
      State S      -> strace: qaysi syscall?
          connect/read socket -> tashqi servis javob bermayapti (timeout yo'q!)
          futex               -> lock kutish / deadlock
          epoll_wait          -> event loop bo'sh (balki ish kelmayapti)
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
grep State /proc/1234/status        # S (sleeping), D (disk), R (running), Z
cat /proc/1234/wchan; echo          # kernel'da qayerda kutyapti
top -H -p 1234                      # thread'lar bo'yicha CPU

sudo strace -fp 1234 -tt -e trace=network,read,write
# 14:02:01.123 connect(7, {sa_family=AF_INET, sin_port=htons(5432), sin_addr=inet_addr("10.0.2.15")}, 16
#   ^ shu yerda turibdi -> DB'ga ulana olmayapti
sudo strace -c -p 1234              # Ctrl-C: qaysi syscall ko'p vaqt oldi

sudo lsof -p 1234 | grep -E 'TCP|REG'
# app 1234 ... TCP 10.0.1.5:43210->10.0.2.15:5432 (SYN_SENT)
sudo tcpdump -i any -nn host 10.0.2.15 and port 5432

# Go ilova
curl -s localhost:6060/debug/pprof/goroutine?debug=2 > goroutines.txt   # process tirik qoladi
# kill -QUIT 1234   -> stack'lar stderr'ga, LEKIN process o'ladi
# Java
jstack 1234 > threads.txt
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `strace` process'ni sezilarli sekinlashtiradi (har syscall'da to'xtatadi) — production'da qisqa vaqt va filtr bilan (`-e trace=`).
- Go'da `kill -QUIT` stack beradi, lekin process'ni tugatadi — pprof endpoint afzal (u faqat ichki tarmoqda bo'lsin).
- `strace` uchun ptrace ruxsati kerak; container'da `CAP_SYS_PTRACE` bo'lmasa ishlamaydi — `nsenter` yoki ephemeral debug container.

**Senior nuqta:** Topilgan ildiz sabab ko'pincha bir xil: tashqi chaqiruvda timeout yo'q yoki lock tartibi. Tuzatish — timeout/context cancellation va regression test; keyingi safar SSH'siz ko'rish uchun pprof, tracing va "in-flight requests" metrikasi.

33016.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Minimal HA: oldida LB (managed yoki 2 ta nginx + keepalived VIP), kamida 2 ta **stateless** app server turli AZ'larda, DB primary + replica avtomatik failover bilan (yoki managed DB Multi-AZ), fayllar obyekt storage'da (S3), session/cache Redis'da. Har komponentda "bittasi o'lsa nima bo'ladi?" savoliga javob bo'lishi kerak.

**Arxitektura:**
```
               DNS
                |
        LB (managed / 2x nginx + VIP)
          |                    |
     app-1 (AZ-a)         app-2 (AZ-b)      stateless, bir xil image/versiya
          \                    /
     Postgres primary  ---->  replica       (Patroni / RDS Multi-AZ, auto-failover)
     S3 (upload fayllar)   Redis (session, cache)
```

**Bir serverdan o'tishda nima o'zgarishi kerak (checklist):**
| Muammo | Yechim |
|---|---|
| upload lokal diskka yoziladi | S3/obyekt storage |
| session xotirada | Redis yoki stateless token |
| cron ikkala serverda ikki marta | bitta job runner yoki distributed lock |
| migratsiya har deploy'da ikki joydan | CI'dan bitta qadam |
| config qo'lda | Ansible/image, ikkala server bir xil |
| log har serverda alohida | markaziy log |

**Health check:**
```bash
curl -f http://app-1:8080/healthz   # liveness: process tirik
curl -f http://app-1:8080/readyz    # readiness: DB'ga ulanadi, so'rov qabul qila oladi
```
LB readiness'ga qarasin; deploy'da instansiya avval LB'dan chiqarilib, keyin to'xtatilsin (graceful drain).

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Ikki app server, lekin bitta DB va bitta LB — SPOF shunchaki boshqa joyga ko'chdi.
- Health check faqat "port ochiq" — app DB'siz ham "sog'lom" ko'rinadi va trafik oladi.
- Readiness DB'ni tekshiradi, DB qisqa uzilsa hamma instansiya bir vaqtda "unready" — butun xizmat o'chadi. Readiness'ni ehtiyot bilan loyihala.
- DB auto-failover'da split-brain — ikkita primary; fencing va kvorum (Patroni + etcd) kerak.

**Senior nuqta:** HA — talab qilinadi, faraz qilinmaydi: game day'da bitta serverni, bitta AZ'ni, DB primary'ni ataylab o'chirib, xizmat va RTO'ni o'lcha. HA murakkablik qo'shadi — avval SLO'ni aniqla: 99.9% uchun nimalar kerak, 99.99% uchun nimalar.

33017.a:
Bosqichlar:
1. Inventar: service'lar, cron, port, sertifikat, secret, firewall, disk, tashqi IP whitelist (to'lov provayderlari!).
2. Yangi server: Ansible/Terraform bilan, eski config'dan nusxa emas.
3. Data: DB uchun replication (lag ~0), fayllar uchun `rsync` bir necha marta (oxirgisi tez).
4. Bir-ikki kun oldin DNS TTL -> 60s.
5. Cutover: write'ni to'xtat -> oxirgi sync -> replika'ni promote -> DNS/LB almashtirish -> smoke test.
6. Rollback: eski server tayyor holda qoladi; teskari replikatsiya agar uzoq.
```
rsync -aHAX --numeric-ids --delete -e ssh /var/lib/app/ new:/var/lib/app/
```
Gotcha: eski IP hardcode qilingan client'lar, DNS'ni hurmat qilmaydigan JVM cache, tashqi tomonda IP whitelist.

33018.a:
```
systemctl list-unit-files --state=enabled
ss -tulpn                                   # nima tinglayapti
# /etc/sysctl.d/99-hardening.conf
net.ipv4.conf.all.rp_filter = 1
net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_redirects = 0
net.ipv4.conf.all.send_redirects = 0
kernel.kptr_restrict = 2
kernel.dmesg_restrict = 1
fs.protected_symlinks = 1
# /etc/fstab: /tmp  nodev,nosuid,noexec
auditctl -w /etc/sudoers -p wa -k sudoers
lynis audit system                           # avtomatik tekshiruv
```
Ilova darajasi: alohida user, systemd sandboxing (`ProtectSystem`, `PrivateTmp`, `CapabilityBoundingSet`).
Senior: hardening bir martalik emas — image'ga kiritiladi va CI'da (lynis/OpenSCAP) tekshiriladi; drift aniqlanadi.

33019.a:
**Qisqa javob:** DB private subnet'da, internetdan ko'rinmaydi. Unga ulanish uchun bastion (jump host) — yagona, qattiq himoyalangan kirish nuqtasi orqali SSH tunnel: `ssh -J` (ProxyJump) ichki serverga o'tish uchun, `ssh -L` (local forward) lokal portni DB'ga ulash uchun. Zamonaviy alternativa — port ochmasdan, IAM va audit bilan AWS SSM Session Manager yoki Teleport.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
laptop                     bastion (public subnet)        db (private subnet)
psql 127.0.0.1:5433 ==SSH shifrlangan==> sshd ----TCP 5432----> db.internal:5432
        ^ ssh -L 5433:db.internal:5432 bastion
SG: bastion 22 <- faqat ofis/VPN IP;  db 5432 <- faqat bastion/app SG
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
# ichki serverga bastion orqali (agent forwarding'siz)
ssh -J deploy@bastion app@10.0.2.15

# DB uchun tunnel (-N: shell ochmaydi)
ssh -N -L 5433:db.internal:5432 deploy@bastion
psql -h 127.0.0.1 -p 5433 -U readonly app
```
```
# ~/.ssh/config
Host bastion
  HostName 203.0.113.5
  User deploy
  IdentityFile ~/.ssh/id_ed25519
Host app-*
  ProxyJump bastion
```
SSM varianti (port 22 umuman yopiq):
```bash
aws ssm start-session --target i-0abc123 \
  --document-name AWS-StartPortForwardingSessionToRemoteHost \
  --parameters host=db.internal,portNumber=5432,localPortNumber=5433
```

**Xavfsizlik (himoya):**
- Bastion minimal: faqat sshd, parol yo'q, MFA yoki SSH sertifikat, `AllowTcpForwarding` faqat kerakli user'larga, `PermitOpen db.internal:5432` bilan yo'nalishni cheklash.
- Agent forwarding (`-A`) ishlatma: bastion buzilsa, hujumchi sizning agent'ingiz orqali boshqa serverlarga kiradi. `ProxyJump` agent'siz ishlaydi.
- Remote forward (`-R`) ichki tarmoqqa tashqi kirish yo'lini ochadi — bastion'da `GatewayPorts no` va odatda taqiqlanadi.
- DB'ga read-only user bilan ulan; sessiyalar log'lansin.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Bastion SG'da 22 `0.0.0.0/0` — butun internet brute force qiladi.
- Tunnel ochiq qoldirilgan, laptop'dagi har qanday dastur 127.0.0.1:5433 orqali prod DB'ga kiradi.
- Hamma bitta umumiy `deploy` kaliti bilan — kim ulanganini bilib bo'lmaydi.

**Senior nuqta:** Bastion — boshqariladigan, patch qilinadigan, audit qilinadigan server; ko'p jamoalar uni identity-aware proxy (SSM, Teleport, Boundary) bilan almashtiradi: inbound port yo'q, kirish SSO va qisqa muddatli huquq bilan, har sessiya yozib olinadi.

33020.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Capacity planning — bitta server (yoki tizim) qancha yukni SLO ichida ko'tarishini **o'lchash** (load test, sinish nuqtasi va bottleneck), o'sish trendini prod metrikalardan **bashorat qilish** va yetarli zahira (headroom, N+1) bilan oldindan kengaytirish. Server "kichik bo'lib qoladi" — p99 latency yoki xato ulushi SLO'dan chiqqanda, CPU 100% bo'lganda emas.

**Jarayon:**
```
1. SLO:          p99 < 300ms, xato < 0.1%
2. load test:    RPS'ni bosqichma-bosqich oshir -> p99 qaysi RPS'da SLO'dan chiqadi?
                 nima birinchi to'yinadi: CPU? DB connection? lock? tarmoq?
3. trend:        prod RPS, disk, DB hajmi oyiga necha % o'syapti
4. hisob:        kerakli server = peak RPS x (1 + headroom) / bitta server RPS, + 1 (N+1)
5. qaror:        qachon va qanday kengaytirish (vertical / horizontal / bottleneck'ni tuzatish)
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
wrk -t4 -c200 -d60s --latency https://staging.example.com/api/items
# Latency Distribution  50% 45ms  99% 410ms   <- SLO buzildi
# Requests/sec: 1850
k6 run --vus 300 --duration 10m load.js      # stsenariy bo'yicha, bosqichli
```
Misol hisob: peak 3000 RPS, bitta server SLO ichida 1000 RPS, headroom 30% -> 3000 x 1.3 / 1000 = 3.9 -> 4 server + 1 (N+1) = 5.

Bashorat (Prometheus):
```
predict_linear(node_filesystem_avail_bytes{mountpoint="/"}[7d], 30*24*3600) < 0   # 30 kunda disk tugaydi
```
USE metodi har resurs uchun: Utilization, Saturation (navbat), Errors.

**Vertical vs horizontal:**
| | Vertical (kattaroq server) | Horizontal (ko'proq server) |
|---|---|---|
| Soddalik | oddiy, kod o'zgarmaydi | stateless bo'lishi shart |
| Chegara | eng katta instansiya | deyarli cheksiz |
| Mavjudlik | SPOF qoladi | biri o'lsa ham ishlaydi |

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Load test real bo'lmagan ma'lumot bilan (bo'sh DB, bitta endpoint, cache issiq) — prod'da natija boshqacha.
- O'rtacha CPU'ga qarash — peak va p99 muhim.
- Bottleneck DB yoki tashqi API bo'lsa, app server qo'shish yordam bermaydi, hatto DB connection'larni ko'paytirib yomonlashtiradi.

**Senior nuqta:** Capacity — iqtisodiy qaror ham: headroom narxini incident narxi bilan solishtir. Har chorakda sinish nuqtasini qayta o'lcha — kod o'zgarishi bilan bitta serverning sig'imi ham o'zgaradi.

33021.a:
1. **Triage (2 min)**: dashboard — error rate, latency, qaysi endpoint/region; boshlangan vaqt.
2. **Kommunikatsiya**: incident kanal, rol: incident commander, status page.
3. **Nima o'zgardi?** deploy, config, feature flag, trafik spike, tashqi provayder, sertifikat.
4. **Mitigation**: rollback, flag o'chirish, scale out, rate limit, bitta yomon node'ni LB'dan chiqarish.
5. **Diagnostika (USE)**:
```
journalctl -u app --since '15 min ago' -p warning
ss -s; uptime; free -h; df -h; dmesg -T | tail
```
6. Barqaror bo'lgach — blameless postmortem: timeline, root cause, nega sezilmadi, action item'lar (egasi + muddat).
Anti-pattern: production'da sababni topguncha tuzatishni kechiktirish. Avval qon to'xtatiladi.

33022.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Immutable infrastructure — ishlab turgan serverni hech qachon o'zgartirmaslik: har o'zgarish yangi image (Packer AMI / container) sifatida quriladi, eski server yangisi bilan **almashtiriladi**. SSH faqat favqulodda (break-glass). Ko'p server, tez-tez deploy, drift muammosi va compliance bo'lsa to'g'ri; 1-2 server va kichik jamoa uchun ko'pincha ortiqcha murakkablik.

**Mutable vs immutable:**
```
mutable:    server --ssh/ansible--> o'zgartir --> o'zgartir --> (drift, snowflake)
immutable:  kod -> build image v42 -> test -> deploy (yangi serverlar) -> eskilarini o'chir
            rollback = v41 image'dan qayta ko'tarish
```

**Yetuklik bosqichlari:**
1. Qo'lda SSH (pet) — 1 server, MVP.
2. Ansible bilan mutable config — bir necha server, takrorlanadigan.
3. Golden image (Packer) + autoscaling group yoki container — SSH faqat break-glass.
4. Kubernetes / serverless — server abstraksiya qilingan.

**Amalda (namuna):**
```hcl
# packer: image yasash
source "amazon-ebs" "app" {
  source_ami_filter { filters = { name = "ubuntu/images/*24.04*" } owners = ["099720477109"] most_recent = true }
  instance_type = "t3.small"
  ami_name      = "app-{{timestamp}}"
}
build {
  sources = ["source.amazon-ebs.app"]
  provisioner "ansible" { playbook_file = "site.yml" }
}
```
```bash
packer build app.pkr.hcl
# Terraform launch template'da yangi AMI -> ASG instance refresh (rolling)
aws autoscaling start-instance-refresh --auto-scaling-group-name app-asg
```

**Qachon to'g'ri:** serverlar soni o'smoqda, drift sababli incident'lar bor, audit/compliance talabi, tez autoscaling, xavfsizlik (SSH yo'q = hujum yuzasi kichik).
**Qachon ortiqcha:** 1-2 server, oyda bir deploy, image pipeline'ni yuritadigan odam yo'q.

**Shartlar (bularsiz immutable og'riqli):**
- Log, metrika, trace server tashqarisida — server o'lsa ham ma'lumot qoladi.
- Holat (DB, fayl) alohida — server ichida hech narsa saqlanmaydi.
- Debug SSH'siz mumkin: pprof endpoint, tracing, SSM ephemeral sessiya.
- Image build tez va avtomatik; xavfsizlik patch'i = yangi image, soatlar ichida.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- "Immutable", lekin har kuni break-glass SSH bilan tuzatish — aslida mutable, faqat yomonroq.
- Image eskiradi: muntazam qayta qurish va CVE scan bo'lmasa, eski paketlar bilan yashaydi.

**Senior nuqta:** Principal savoli: "Bu complexity qaysi muammoni hal qiladi va uni qanday o'lchaymiz?" — drift incident'lari soni, MTTR, deploy chastotasi. Muammo yo'q joyda pattern qo'llash — xarajat.
